inputs: models/<market>/<code>/assumptions.json: optional g_lo/g_mode/g_hi overrides (local-only, checked at runtime)

lineage.source: DCF house axiom (tower dcf-universal-law) + Mauboussin, Expectations Investing (2001) + Rappaport CAP
lineage.note: reverse-DCF reuses core_triad.implied_growth; MC = PERT three-point 10y FCFF + Gordon, linear fade years 6-10

parameters.g: PERT(g_lo,g_mode,g_hi)% default from rev_yoy (lo=max(rev,-5)-5, mode=clamp(rev,-10,20), hi=mode+5)

limits: FCF-less rows (HK/US imputed fcf_yield): MC+CAP data_gap unless PE-positive earnings-yield proxy accepted (declared per-run)
earnings-yield proxy overstates FCF -> implied_g is a lower-bound read
PERT defaults are declared heuristics, not forecasts; override via params or AI dossier
growth fades linearly to terminal over years 6-10 (declared)
